articles.title: NVIDIA Announces Collaboration With IBM and Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory to Launch Quantum-Classical Codesign Platform, Plus Error-Correction Breakthrough to Advance Practical Quantum Computing
articles.summary: NVIDIA today announced plans for new collaborations with IBM and the U.S. Department of Energy’s Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory that will span research into next-generation modular architectures for quantum computers, scientific applications and supercomputing integration.

articles.title: NVIDIA Expands Vera CPU Platform to Accelerate Scientific Discovery
articles.summary: NVIDIA today announced the NVIDIA Vera CPU rack-scale platform for high-performance computing — combining NVIDIA’s first fully custom data center CPU with the gold standard for HPC networking to drive extreme efficiency and throughput for state-of-the-art scientific modeling, simulation and agentic science.

articles.title: NVIDIA Introduces Nemotron for Science to Accelerate Discoveries With Agents
articles.summary: NVIDIA today introduced NVIDIA Nemotron for Science, bringing together scientific applications of its NVIDIA Nemotron™ 3.5 Super VL open model, a new open chemistry dataset and post-training recipes to help researchers build specialized agents for scientific discovery.

articles.title: NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition
articles.summary: NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) Board of Directors announced today that Jensen Huang has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately.

articles.title: Statement From the Independent Members of the NVIDIA Board
articles.summary: The independent members of the NVIDIA Board have retained former acting U.S. Attorney of the Southern District of New York Joon H. Kim and his firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to conduct a thorough and independent investigation as was announced on Sunday.
